build:
seagull-agent v0.1.0-rc.1.0.20261019174702-003731be03b0 go1.26.9 linux/amd64
contracts v0.19.0
protocol_version 1
event_schema_version 1
inventory_schema_version 1
status_schema_version 1
policy_schema_version 1
update_schema_version 1
assessment_schema_version 1
method: every sample reads the control group of seagull-agent.service, which holds the agent and every program it runs, and procfs for each process in it

processor: usage_usec of cpu.stat, as the share of one processor over the workload; processor_peak over its busiest 5s; throttled: throttled_usec of cpu.stat over the same time; own_processor: utime and stime of the agent's /proc/PID/stat, without the programs it runs
memory: memory.current of the control group, page cache included; anonymous: anon of memory.stat, the memory no file backs
resident and resident_peak: VmRSS and VmHWM of the agent's process; others_resident: VmRSS of the programs it runs
threads and descriptors: Threads of the agent's process and the entries of its /proc/PID/fd; tasks: pids.current of the control group

read and written: rchar and wchar of /proc/PID/io summed over the processes, what they asked of files, pipes and sockets; storage_read and storage_written: read_bytes and write_bytes, what reached the storage layer; a process the agent reaped counts in the agent's
goroutines and heap_held: what the agent's status says, rewritten every 30 seconds; spooled: the bytes of the files under spool/; outstanding: the records the status says wait for delivery
received, sent and connections: the bytes and connections the emulated platform's ingest and renewal listeners took and gave, TLS records included
latency_ms: from the time journald gave an outcome to when the platform took its event, for the events taken during the workload

workloads.load: nothing to collect, the status written and reported
60000 outcomes as fast as one writer hands them to journald, up to 1000 a second
10 outcomes a second while the platform answers 503 backbone_unavailable
the 1200 events held while the platform was out, delivered once it is back
120000 outcomes up to 1000 a second while the platform is out and spool.max_bytes is 16MiB
the 120000 events the spool and the journal held, delivered once the platform is back
the agent started on its installation and took stock of the host
the files module enabled on the paths it watches by default, taking their baseline
authentication, inventory, processes, files, network and assessment started at once with the documented drop-ins
10 outcomes a second with every module running
